title: Verificar publicación y health del candidate texto → audio
mission: Independently verify the isolated generic text-to-audio candidate after Pages propagation using read-only/public requests. Verify the exact public HTML and the existing backend health endpoint without triggering a new TTS generation. Report mismatches; do not promote authority.
definition_of_done: The public candidate URL returns HTML containing the candidate marker and audio-lab-page-audio-v1 backend reference, or an exact serving failure is recorded.
A non-destructive GET to audio-lab-page-audio-v1 without an id returns health metadata consistent with maxChars=1800 and the recovered service, or the exact divergence is recorded.
No POST generation is sent merely for verification.
Any source-vs-served mismatch is persisted with exact URLs and timestamps.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog or /w authority pointer changes.
